look: Shardling Thicket, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Shardlings family: walking hedge of glassy thorns and tangled roots. Family anatomy: living saplings and trees of bark and roots with crystal buds and geode hollows. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are pale green quartz. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, modest stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
